question: Which clause of Article 51A of the Constitution of India requires to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture?
solution:
The correct answer is Clause f. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Clause (f) of Article 51A** specifically calls for **citizens to value and preserve the rich heritage of India’s composite culture.**
 
• **Article 51A is located in Part IV-A of the Constitution, **which details the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
• These duties were** introduced by the 42nd Amendment Act of 1976** during the internal emergency period of 1975-771.
 
• An **additional duty was added by the 86th Amendment Act of 2002,** making it a total of 11 Fundamental Duties.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are moral obligations and **are not enforceable by law.**
 
 
• ​They apply only to citizens of India and do not extend to foreigners
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Clause ____(a__)**

 __
 
• ​ **Every Indian must follow the Constitution, and respect the National Flag, Anthem, and institutions.**
 
• "The clause stresses respecting India's constitutional framework and national symbols."
 
 
 
• **Clause (c)**__
 __
 
• This **clause obligates every citizen to uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India.** 
 
• Citizens have a collective responsibility to maintain the nation's independence and unity despite diverse backgrounds.
 
 
 
• **Clause (d)__**
 
 
• It **mandates citizens to defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so.**
 
• Citizens have a collective responsibility to maintain the nation's independence and unity despite diverse backgrounds.
 
 

6f
